scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 execute scheduler-pro-db --local --file=./migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute scheduler-pro-db --local --file=./migrations/0003_app_settings.sql
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.pages:dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev ./dist --d1=DB=scheduler-pro-db --local
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy ./dist
